messages.subject: tryCatching errors in server.R
parts:
Hi. I want to alert myself when the user takes certain actions. I have a line like this in server.R:
stop (simpleCondition ("userQuit"))

Now I want to catch that error. I tried wrapping runApp() in my own function and using tryCatch() and withConditionHandlers() to call runApp(), and I also copied runApp and edited the copy to try to include error handling. In every case, though, the error caused control to jump all the way back to the command line. Can anyone think of a way around this?

Thanks,
Sam Buttrey

messages.author: f806781d102fe0ab
messages.subject: Re: tryCatching errors in server.R
parts:
Your tryCatch needs to look like this:

tryCatch(runApp(...), simpleCondition=function(cond) {...})
